prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1442; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- A few old scratches may be older than this crash.
text: The rear quarter panel on the driver's side shows a long dent with paint transfer along the edge, and the damage pattern lines up well with a sideswipe during a lane change. The rear bumper cover has a cracked corner and a scuffed mounting bracket. Several small scratches sit near the wheel arch, and some of these may be older than this crash, so they have been noted separately and are not included in the repair scope. Labor hours requested fit the extent of the work, and the repair plan calls for panel straightening, paint blending, and replacement of the bumper cover. The billing records reviewed show no repeated charges for the same operations.
